title: Encryption/Ciphered Reasoning x CoT Monitoring: Compounding Capability Trends Against Oversight

original_idea.body: Prompt a model to solve control tasks while progressively encoding its CoT and measure task accuracy and CoT-monitor detection at each level, mapping the frontier where the model stays competent but the monitor goes blind.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Mapping where ciphered reasoning blinds CoT monitoring is a forward-looking early-warning indicator for the strongest control signal.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt progressively-ciphered CoT, measure accuracy and detection; prompt-only, accessible.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Forward-looking over-1yr monitorability question labs deprioritize, lab-independent.

novelty.reasoning: Ciphered-reasoning and obfuscation studied; the accuracy-vs-monitorability frontier may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Ciphered reasoning studied; the graded-frontier mapping may be open.
